results.name: graphics-snippets | Shading techniques and GLSL snippets
results.snippet: The thickness of the line should be set in pixel unit ( uniform float u_thickness). The coordinates have to be transformed from model space to window space. For that the resolution of the viewport has to be known ( uniform vec2 u_resolution). Don't forget the perspective divide. The drawing of the line will even work at perspective projection.
